findings.what: Other live dispatch-ledger readers still trust unsigned ok:true records. coverage-gate.evaluate() accepts a forged unsigned row with dispatch_id, cmdline_checksum, current argv_schema_version, output_digest, role, provider, and shape; sprint-manager-consult.js and sprint-hook-coverage.js use the same unsigned ok:true backing-record predicate.
findings.why: This violates the round-3 claim that no other live liveness reader omits signature verification. A hand-authored dispatch-completions row can still satisfy blocking coverage/consult gates outside gauntlet-verify/applyPanelGate/verifyTyped.

findings.what: verifyTyped now requires signatures by default, but the live sealed-capsule telemetry child is spawned with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and all WARPOS_* env scrubbed, so the installed child signs with the isolated repo secret while the parent verifier uses the canonical secret.
findings.why: Legitimate telemetry records from the sealed consumer path will fail verifyRecord unless a shared WARPOS_ATTEST_SECRET_FILE is deliberately threaded or verification is performed with the consumer secret. The default-on fix closes forged rows but regresses the cold/warm sealed-capsule liveness gate into false-red.

parsed.summary: Round-3 fixes themselves are mostly verified: gauntlet-verify trusted fields role/ok/provider/completed_at/started_at/sprint_id/fallback are signed, verifyTyped defaults requireSignature on, applyPanelGate live path requires signatures, and Alex/alpha/Greek-alpha aliases are blocked without false positives on alexa-connector/alpha-tester/alexander. Focused direct tests passed for role-resolver, gauntlet-verify-signing, dispatch-review-panel-gate, authority-pollution-scan, and conformance-matrix; node --test/CLI-spawn cases hit sandbox EPERM, not a code assertion failure. Verdict remains fail due the two remaining high defects above.
